answer: Like an oyster layering nacre around grit until a luminous pearl emerges, decentralized consensus demands recursive cryptographic crystallization. An agent binds its identity to an iterative proof-of-work seed as rugged as an ancient walnut shell, which web-of-trust peers verify through staked reputation carved like precious jade. Minting forged identities incurs superlinear attacker cost, suffocating swarm clones before they germinate.
